out.summary: Trent Ltd is a Tata-group retailer operating fashion & lifestyle brands (Westside, Zudio, Samoh, Burnt Toast) plus food & grocery (Star, via 50:50 JV with Tesco), with 1,286 stores across 321 cities. FY26 standalone total income grew 18% to ₹20,075.87 Cr with PAT of ₹1,967.82 Cr, though like-for-like growth was low single digits and Star/THPL remains loss-making.
out.how_it_makes_money: Revenue comes mainly from fashion & lifestyle retail through Westside (300 stores) and Zudio (963 stores) selling exclusive in-house brands, plus Star food & grocery (84 stores, THPL total income ₹2,773.55 Cr) and 20% stakes in Zara/Massimo Dutti India JVs.

bull.point: Strong revenue growth and margin expansion
bull.quote: The Company has reported total income of ` 20,075.87 Crore (` 16,997.48 Crore in FY25), a growth of 18%
Over 90% of Westside’s revenues are attributable to its loyal WSC members

bear.quote: For the fashion portfolio the like for like growth during FY26 was in the low single digits

bear.point: Star grocery JV continues to lose money
bear.quote: THPL loss before exceptional items and tax in FY26 is ` 127.92 Crore as compared to ` 91.96 Crore in FY25

bear.point: Zara/Massimo Dutti stakes carry valuation risk due to Inditex control
bear.quote: it may be appropriate to take cognisance of the related uncertainties and risks involved in the valuation of the associated economics

watch.point: Whether new-store SPSF in Tier II/III markets matures as expected
watch.quote: the SPSF profile for our business continues to be influenced by our portfolio expansion choices and approach

watch.point: Whether Star's refit-driven traction translates into lower losses
watch.quote: in the second half of the year Star witnessed strong consumer traction, reflected in robust growth in footfalls
